The success notification for comment editing now lives in the mutation hook, and the component no longer calls `useNotifications`. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`**: `useUpdateComment` imports `useNotifications` and calls `addNotification({ type: 'success', title: 'Comment Updated' })` inside `onSuccess`, after the comment list invalidation and before the caller's `onSuccess`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and call, and the `mutationConfig` that only existed to show the toast. The component now calls `useUpdateComment({ discussionId })`.

The other comment and discussion components (`create-comment.tsx`, `delete-comment.tsx`, `update-discussion.tsx`, `create-discussion.tsx`, `delete-discussion.tsx`, `delete-user.tsx`, `update-profile.tsx`) also call `useNotifications` directly. That predates this change, so I left them alone. They break the same rule and would need the same move in a separate refactor.
